blocks.text: Evicted “Pinoy Big Brother” housemate Ethan Benares issued an apology to Gehlee Dangca and her family as he addressed the “dinosaur” issue that involved him and other male housemates. Benares spoke about the matter during his guest appearance on the talk show “Kalurks” on Sunday, Nov. 15. “It started po with Calix nung tinawag siyang Good Dinosaur kasi kamukha niya si Arlo,” Benares explained, referring to the Disney-Pixar character. “From there po, si Kuya Raheel started saying, ‘That’s my dinosaur,’ then Kuya Anthony started calling me his dinosaur din, then si Kuya Robbie calls Jeo his dinosaur.” “At first po it […]...
